chapter_title: Concerning the Five Wonders that the Light Mind sh

fills.notes: Accepting the editor’s restoration: it fits the impersonal, operative agency of the Light Mind and governs the following series of perfectives (“purified, cleansed, supported and chosen”) as effects in the recipient.

fills.fill: in order that they may appear as five witnesses in him
fills.notes: The correspondential logic is: the Light Mind “puts” the five signs within the new man (an interior vessel), after purification/cleansing/support/choice (successive ordering of degrees), so that the signs become manifest as attestations. “Witnesses” matches the function of “signs” as self-evidencing forms of Light in ultimates, without shifting into later devotional/register language.

assessment: ¶7 #1 is fixed by syntax and register. ¶7 #2 is recoverable in sense: the missing clause should state the purpose/effect of implanting the five signs—namely their manifestation/attestation in the regenerated (new) man. Exact wording remains somewhat open, but the function is tightly constrained by the correspondential sequence.
